author: Bryan Guffey
message:
fix(site): re-verify the handle before promoting from the waitlist

Waitlist rows saved before join-time verification may hold a
PDS-claimed handle, and promotion inserts that handle into the
allowlist pinned to the waitlister's DID, which could capture an
invitee's unpinned row. promoteFromWaitlist now takes a resolver
(production: verifiedHandle) and refuses unless the appview confirms
the same handle, and refuses when the allowlist row for that handle is
already pinned to a different DID. Nothing is written on refusal.

author: Bryan Guffey
message:
fix(security): match invites with an appview-verified handle only

loadBskyProfile falls back to the user's own PDS when the appview says
handle.invalid, so its handle is a claim anyone running a PDS can make.
That claimed handle fed checkAllowlist (which pins the DID), late passes,
the gates, viewerTier and the photo route.

New verifiedHandle(did, kv?) (appview-only loadBskyProfiles, appview:
cache, cleanHandle, 2.5 s timeout, never throws) now supplies the handle
for every allowlist / late-pass / tier / gate lookup: `/` load (gates,
checkAllowlist, siteFor, waitlist backfill), register, decline,
joinWaitlist, /media/site/[id] and PUT /api/response. Null → DID-only.
The display profile stays as is. Resolves #125 for these call sites.

Also on `/`: cache-control private, no-store; loadOrganizer runs in
parallel with the base gates behind a 2 s timeout.

author: Bryan Guffey
message:
feat: Bluesky DM channel for organizer broadcasts

The broadcast panel can now send to an audience as Bluesky DMs as well
as email. DMs go out from a dedicated sending account signed in with an
app password (BSKY_DM_HANDLE + BSKY_DM_APP_PASSWORD secrets) — the
organizer's own OAuth session is pinned to the `atproto` scope, so chat
can't ride on it. Each send is getConvoForMembers → sendMessage through
the PDS with the chat-service proxy header; URLs become link facets.

- src/lib/server/bsky-dm.ts: session, handle resolution, sendDm with the
  same SendResult shape as email so runBroadcast is channel-agnostic.
  Recipient-side refusals (MessagesDisabled, NotFollowedBySender, blocks,
  …) mark the row failed; 401/429/5xx/network pause the run for Retry.
- broadcasts.ts: `channel` on broadcasts, `handle` on recipient rows
  (migration 0009). Audience resolution is split into audienceMembers
  (one per DID) and a per-channel recipient list — email still dedupes by
  address; DM keeps everyone, so people with no or shared emails are
  reachable. Counts are per channel.
- Organizer: dmTest / dmBroadcast actions; emailRetry becomes
  retryBroadcast and branches on the stored channel.
- EmailPanel: Email / Bluesky DM toggle, subject hidden for DMs, live
  1000-grapheme counter (shared src/lib/dm-text.ts), test-by-handle,
  channel-aware counts and history.

author: Bryan Guffey
message:
fix: bestWindows no longer requires availability on the departure morning

Two compounding problems made the ranking miss real candidates:

1. The window shape required a day-3 first-half slot — a 4th calendar
   day of availability for a 3-night stay. The survey's end-portion
   semantics ('full' vs 'leaving midday') already encode the last
   night, so anyone who entered exactly the weekend they meant
   (Fri-Sun) matched zero windows. Verified against prod data: one
   respondent's six weekend ranges all counted for nothing.
2. The top list allowed overlapping windows, so shifted copies of one
   peak crowded out distinct alternatives. The list is now greedily
   de-clustered (non-overlapping), and the organizer view shows 5.

On today's data this surfaces Fri Oct 23-26 as the true best window
(11 of 16, previously invisible) and puts Fri Oct 2-5 (10 of 16) on
the board — it previously ranked 8th at 9 and never displayed.

author: Bryan Guffey
message:
fix: resolve workerd export conditions in Vite SSR build

Vite's SSR resolver defaults to node conditions, baking @atcute's
node-flavored builds (bare Buffer.prototype.base64urlSlice.call) into the
worker bundle; workerd's stricter Buffer polyfill throws 'The "start"
argument must be of type number' on every OAuth login. Resolve with
workerd/worker conditions so the packages' own pure-JS web builds ship.

Root-caused from Bryan's smoke-test HAR + local workerd repro.
